No starting section; the Objective (posted 'Plead My Case to the Senate/Sanity And Compassion' under 'Objetive') is the starting card and counts toward the 60.

The description calls it a 'tipo II' (Type II, Episode I-only) deck; format left as set — Bill to decide. Accordingly the Coruscant-set printings are used for 'Coruscant' (Coruscant (Light) (Coruscant)), 'Coruscant Docking bay' (Coruscant: Docking Bay (Coruscant), the Light printing), 'Control' (Control (Coruscant)) and 'Sense' (Sense (Light) (Coruscant)).
Posted 'I'decide to go back x4' dested the Coruscant Light Interrupt I've Decided To Go Back (moves politicians from the Galactic Senate), kept x4 as published.

Posted 'Supreme Cancelor Valorum' dested Supreme Chancellor Valorum; 'Sel Taria' Sei Taria; 'Liutenant Williams' Lieutenant Williams; 'Ric Olié' Ric Olie; 'The Gravest Of Circustances' The Gravest Of Circumstances; 'I will no Defer' I Will Not Defer; 'Speak With Jedi Council' Speak With The Jedi Council; 'Stay Here Where It'is Safe' Stay Here, Where It's Safe.
